note: The only core fit in this batch and close to the ICP as literally stated. A 33-year-old financial advisor who has been building his own practice — 'something along those lines' to the business-owner archetype — with no price resistance whatsoever at $6,000. Health is precisely the neglected area rather than a crisis, by his own account: 'fitness has not been as big of a goal for me just because I've been getting my business started... I've kind of let that side of my life go.' The ask is good-to-great in his own words — 'I'm not, you know, terribly out of shape. I just want to get back to my peak shape again' — and he is nowhere near the exclusion: ex-college football player, 208 lb heading to 190, actively lifting. Worth recording alongside the rest of the batch: the textbook ICP prospect closed in eighteen minutes with no objections and no discovery of any substance, while the two prospects who required the most work and disclosed the most risk fell well outside the stated criteria. The stated ICP describes who is easy to sell, not who turns up.
